name: jev-claude-orchestrator
description: Madmax conductor for Claude Code: a frontier model plans many tiny slices, subagents write the code, and TypeSafe Jev makes every routing, review, QA and supervision decision in under a second for fractions of a cent.

health_every.title: Health check every N tool calls
health_every.description: How often Jev checks a slice worker for stuck / off-track behaviour. 0 disables it.

max_blocks.title: Max stop blocks per slice
max_blocks.description: How many times the stop gate sends a worker back before escalating the slice to the conductor.
